item.title: Hydrophane opal can absorb water
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Some Ethiopian opal is hydrophane. Its porous structure allows it to absorb water.
EXIMUTC view: Ask for care instructions specific to the opal before choosing a piece of jewelry.
Source: www.gia.edu https://www.gia.edu/gems-gemology/fa13-ln-technique-hydrophane-opal

item.title: Iolite can show three colors when viewed from different directions
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: This directional color effect is called pleochroism.
EXIMUTC view: Compare the face-up and side views before judging a finished stone.
Source: www.gia.edu https://www.gia.edu/iolite
